photos.title: 1. Photos
photos.hint: Pick the photos this video is built from.

setup.storyIntro: Writes the story, the common prompt and the negative prompt together, so all three stay consistent with the tone and style you chose. Review and edit them below before continuing.
setup.storyGeneratedMsg: Story, common prompt and negative prompt written — review them below.
setup.storyFailed: Failed to generate the story setup
setup.storyModalIntro: Optionally tell us more about this project — for example, the purpose of a trip or how you want it to feel. We'll use it to write the story and common prompt. You can leave this blank.
setup.storyModalPlaceholder: e.g. A family trip to Okinawa. Seeing our grandparents again after three years was the whole point.
setup.scenesFillAll: Write {count} scene(s) with AI ({count} AI calls)

style.name: Style name

commonPrompt.placeholder: Common prompt applied to every scene

story.intro: Defines the shared narrative and worldview for every scene. It is seeded from photo analysis and composed into every image prompt.
story.placeholder: Story and worldview shared by all scenes

deleteScope.unfilled: Only scenes AI has not filled ({count})

deleteScopeWarning.all: This deletes every scene in this storyboard. Titles, descriptions, image prompts and photo assignments are lost and cannot be restored. Unsaved edits are discarded too.
deleteScopeWarning.unfilled: This deletes only scenes that still have blank fields — the same test that decides which scenes “Fill all with AI” bills for. It cannot be undone, and unsaved edits are discarded too.

complement.insertBlankTitle: Insert a blank complement scene here
complement.modalHint: Pick a bridging scene to insert. You can edit it before saving.
complement.appliedReview: Proposal applied — review and Save scenes

negativePrompt.intro: Phrases to keep OUT of every scene's image generation. This is the fence that keeps a series inside its intended look. A base floor (watermarks, deformed hands, …) is always applied on top of this. Do not add text-related terms when place names, station names, building names, or other signs should remain visible.
negativePrompt.placeholder: Things to avoid (e.g. watermark, extra people)

characterPolicy.intro: Decide once whether this story should feature a character. This is what stops an uninvited character from appearing in a story built from a plain landscape photo.
characterPolicy.generateSheet: Generate character reference sheet (1 paid image call)

options.featured: Featured — the story centers on a character

options.none: None — no human figures beyond what a source photo shows

disabled.hint: Set GEN_STORY_AGENT_CHAT_RUNTIME=codex (or claude) in apps/api/.env and restart the API. It uses your existing subscription login — no API key — and leaves the rest of the app's AI settings alone.
